rules: Documented conservative estimates and sensitivities are allowed; future forecasts need not be issuer-proven facts
Keep reported source values, economic adjustments and forecasts separate
Qualification inside arithmetic functions certifies explicit scenario inputs, not formal source or score admission
Do not mix standalone/group scopes or allocate groupcash/NCI by an invented percentage
No bankCFO-minus-capex valuation and no genericdeveloperRNAV for a hotel merely because sector metadata says realestate
Current provisionalpublicshares are reference evidence; retain issue, treasury and conversion uncertainties
No unweighted renormalization of incomplete scores; RG-UNCzero is an assessed high-uncertainty band, not a missing-data substitution
LOWconfidence does not authorize newcapital; no review candidate grants production authority
